title: Research: certify the sharp two-frame P112 repair obstruction
body:
## Summary

```diff
 P112 partitions retaining at least eleven PR3356 full frames
- two-frame repair: unproved negative SAT reports
+ exact minimum: sixteen even orthonormal groups
+ fifteen-group construction must disturb at least three original frames
```

The unchanged PR3370 witness attains sixteen groups. The new proof independently exhausts every two-original-frame-plus-tail repair. This gives a sharp 32-support minimum for the two-support-per-group recipe in this retained-frame class. It is not an arbitrary-fitting-rank lower bound. Unrestricted fifteen-group attainment remains open; no new kappa or supplier is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3370 reports 78 four-group SAT repair cases without checked negative proofs. **After:** complementary two-group unions exclude all 78 complete 24-port domains; a separately implemented explicit-coordinate cover search agrees on every case, visiting 9,653 unique states, at most 985 per case. Exact per-case counts and proof are committed.
- Both full checks and 36 complete small-domain controls, nine rejection fixtures and two cover fixtures pass in ordinary and optimized Python. Five optimized actual-CLI mutations reject bad sources, a false result receipt and omitted certificate pins. Ruff diagnostics and formatting pass.
- Registered replay: `python3 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-even-group-attainment`. Source/publication-byte and declared-history preflight passes on all 14 required files. An exact committed Git-free export passes all six checks on Python 3.14, separately from the Python 3.12 registered run.
- Canonical base is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, refreshed unchanged. Exact PR3356 and PR3370 certificate bytes are retained and independently matched to their public source commits; no pending Git object or solver is required for proof replay.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19008359). Credit Nick Petalas/PR3356 and PR3373, Tekalign/PR3370 and its sharp upper witness and prior SAT reports, Matarener/Mark/PR3335, ctoth, ywz65, Sagar Thakrar, Cinna Davis, Adam Gall, Jeremy Diviney, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained selected lineage.

Bounded construction pilots found no fifteen-group witness; their UNKNOWN and unproved UNSAT reports are excluded from the theorem. Full native pricing, acquisition, restoration, hosting, precision, all-size/compiler admission, both suppliers, outer transfer and independent human/formal review remain separate. The selected cold replay and hosted CI are not claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Thirteen new files in one isolated research package. Frozen inputs, shared code and the selected frontier are unchanged.
